meta.desc: D3 评测集：30 条业务问句。evaluate 采用「执行结果比对」而非字符串比对 SQL——写 SQL 有无数种写法，跑出来的数据集一致才算对。

types.sql: 期望可执行 SQL，比对结果集
types.glossary: 期望命中业务口径条目，比对 metric_name
types.refuse: 负样本，期望礼貌拒答而不是硬生成 SQL

cases.q: 各省份装机容量排名
cases.sql: SELECT p.province AS province, ROUND(SUM(p.capacity_mw),2) AS cap FROM dim_plant p GROUP BY p.province ORDER BY cap DESC

cases.q: 发电量最高的 10 个电站
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh), 0) AS gen FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_id ORDER BY gen DESC, p.plant_name LIMIT 10

cases.q: 本月等效利用小时排名前 5 的省份
cases.sql: SELECT province, ROUND(SUM(gen) / SUM(cap) / 1000, 2) AS eq FROM (SELECT p.province AS province, p.plant_id, SUM(f.generation_kwh) AS gen, p.capacity_mw AS cap FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-08' GROUP BY p.plant_id) GROUP BY province ORDER BY eq DESC, province LIMIT 5
cases.note: 评测时钟冻结在数据截止日（EVAL_NOW），本月=2026-08

cases.q: 逆变器转换效率最低的 5 个电站
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, ROUND(p.inverter_efficiency,4) AS eff FROM dim_plant p ORDER BY p.inverter_efficiency ASC, p.plant_name LIMIT 5

cases.q: 全国总装机容量是多少
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(capacity_mw),2) AS total_mw FROM dim_plant

cases.q: 上个月总发电量是多少
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh), 0) AS gen FROM fact_daily_generation f WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-07'

cases.q: 所有电站平均等效利用小时
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gen / cap / 1000), 2) AS avg_eq_hours FROM (SELECT p.plant_id, SUM(f.generation_kwh) AS gen, p.capacity_mw AS cap FROM fact_daily_generation f JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = f.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_id)

cases.q: 平均弃光率是多少
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.curtailment_kwh)/(SUM(f.generation_kwh)+SUM(f.curtailment_kwh)),4) AS curt_rate FROM fact_daily_generation f

cases.q: 本月发电量较去年同期增长多少
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND((cur-prev)/prev,4) AS yoy FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',stat_date)='2026-08' THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',stat_date)='2025-08' THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM fact_daily_generation)

cases.q: 山东省本月发电量环比上月变化
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND((cur-prev)/prev,4) AS mom FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',f.stat_date)='2026-08' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',f.stat_date)='2026-07' THEN f.generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM fact_daily_generation f JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = f.plant_id WHERE p.province = '山东')

cases.q: 今年前三季度发电量同比去年
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND((cur-prev)/prev,4) AS yoy FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2026' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS cur, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2025' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM fact_daily_generation)

cases.q: Q2 发电量环比 Q1 变化多少
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND((q2-q1)/q1,4) AS mom FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2026' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS q2, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y',stat_date)='2026' AND CAST(strftime('%m',stat_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN generation_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS q1 FROM fact_daily_generation)

cases.q: 集中式与分布式装机容量各占多少
cases.sql: SELECT station_type, ROUND(SUM(capacity_mw),2) AS cap_mw, ROUND(100.0*SUM(capacity_mw)/(SELECT SUM(capacity_mw) FROM dim_plant),2) AS pct FROM dim_plant GROUP BY station_type ORDER BY cap_mw DESC

cases.q: 各省份装机占比分别是多少
cases.sql: SELECT province, ROUND(SUM(capacity_mw),2) AS cap_mw, ROUND(100.0*SUM(capacity_mw)/(SELECT SUM(capacity_mw) FROM dim_plant),2) AS pct FROM dim_plant GROUP BY province ORDER BY cap_mw DESC

cases.q: 西北大基地占全国装机比例是多少
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN region='西北' AND station_type='集中式' THEN capacity_mw ELSE 0 END)/SUM(capacity_mw),2) AS pct FROM dim_plant

cases.q: 上月发电量低于 100 万 kWh 的电站有哪些
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh),0) AS gen FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) = '2026-07' GROUP BY p.plant_id HAVING gen < 1000000 ORDER BY gen DESC LIMIT 200
cases.note: 口径歧义样例：「发电量」未限定周期，理想行为是反问澄清（D4 提问五要素解决）

cases.q: 近一年等效利用小时低于 1500 的电站
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh) / p.capacity_mw / 1000, 2) AS eq_hours FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE f.stat_date >= date('2026-08-31', '-12 months') GROUP BY p.plant_id HAVING SUM(f.generation_kwh) / p.capacity_mw / 1000 < 1500 ORDER BY eq_hours DESC LIMIT 200

cases.q: 装机容量大于 200MW 的集中式电站
cases.sql: SELECT plant_name, province, capacity_mw FROM dim_plant WHERE capacity_mw > 200 AND station_type = '集中式' ORDER BY capacity_mw DESC LIMIT 200

cases.q: 弃光率超 5% 的电站有哪些
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, ROUND(SUM(f.curtailment_kwh)/(SUM(f.generation_kwh)+SUM(f.curtailment_kwh)),4) AS curt_rate FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id GROUP BY p.plant_id HAVING curt_rate > 0.05 ORDER BY curt_rate DESC LIMIT 200
cases.note: 业务黑话样例：弃光率写成了「超 5%」而不是字段名

cases.q: 过去 12 个月全国月度发电量趋势
cases.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', stat_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(generation_kwh),0) AS gen FROM fact_daily_generation WHERE stat_date >= date('2026-08-31', '-12 months') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.q: 近半年发电量最高的那个电站，按月的发电量变化
cases.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', f.stat_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh),0) AS gen FROM fact_daily_generation f WHERE f.stat_date >= date('2026-08-31', '-6 months') AND f.plant_id = (SELECT f2.plant_id FROM fact_daily_generation f2 WHERE f2.stat_date >= date('2026-08-31', '-6 months') GROUP BY f2.plant_id ORDER BY SUM(f2.generation_kwh) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.q: 各季度发电量走势
cases.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', stat_date) || '-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', stat_date) AS INTEGER)+2)/3) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(generation_kwh),0) AS gen FROM fact_daily_generation GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.q: 山东省下各电站的发电量分别是多少
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, ROUND(SUM(f.generation_kwh), 0) AS gen FROM dim_plant p JOIN fact_daily_generation f ON f.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE p.province = '山东' GROUP BY p.plant_id ORDER BY gen DESC LIMIT 200

cases.q: 使用阳光电源逆变器的电站平均转换效率
cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(inverter_efficiency), 4) AS avg_eff FROM dim_plant WHERE inverter_brand = '阳光电源'

cases.q: 按设备类型统计各电站故障次数，取前 10
cases.sql: SELECT p.plant_name AS plant_name, d.device_type AS device_type, COUNT(*) AS fault_cnt FROM fact_device_fault fl JOIN dim_device d ON d.device_id = fl.device_id JOIN dim_plant p ON p.plant_id = fl.plant_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY fault_cnt DESC, p.plant_name, d.device_type LIMIT 10
